about.description: SPX500 is an index perpetual listed on MEXC, tracking S&P 500 Index, margined and cash-settled in USDC. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 50x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
